callability.evidence: No real API response has been obtained. model_not_found or access_denied must stop the run without fallback.

model_id_evidence.documentation_evidence: Official OpenAI model documentation lists gpt-5.6-sol and medium reasoning. This is documentation evidence only; account-level API callability is not verified.

execution_environment.image_fingerprint: GitHub-hosted image version is recorded per run; actual Actions image has not been tested in this repository.
execution_environment.pinning: Fixed ubuntu-24.04 runner label and exact Python patch; runtime host image version is captured in each raw record.

execution_trace_capture.api_smoke_method: One forced diagnostic function_call in one real request; record response metadata and append its deterministic local tool result to trace without a second request.
execution_trace_capture.pilot_method: Preserve full Responses API request/response items, function calls/results, hosted web_search items, errors, and timestamps in each raw run.

temperature.evidence: The request omits temperature identically for all rule variants; no numeric value is asserted.

network_access.evidence: The Work executor is not used as the benchmark host. GitHub Actions connectivity remains unverified until manually dispatched runtime smoke modes.

persistence.credential_source: GitHub Actions automatically provided github.token; no custom GITHUB_TOKEN secret is required.

request.failure_policy: Save error and partial trace; never silently retry a run or relabel it successful.

shared_instruction.rule_injection: Append exactly one selected rule body for each independent run.

state_policy.within_run_tool_feedback: Only the current run input, its own model output items, and its own tool results may be carried to a subsequent Responses request.

superseded_model_candidate.reason: Replaced by the user-selected current candidate before any real API callability test.

benchmark_function_tools.description: Evaluate a numeric arithmetic expression for this testcase.
benchmark_function_tools.name: benchmark_calculate

benchmark_function_tools.description: Read a UTF-8 file from this run's isolated testcase workspace; paths are relative to that workspace.
benchmark_function_tools.name: benchmark_read_fixture

benchmark_function_tools.description: Search source files in this run's isolated repo/ fixture and return matching paths and lines.
benchmark_function_tools.name: benchmark_repo_search

benchmark_function_tools.description: Read one file from this run's isolated repo/ fixture.
benchmark_function_tools.name: benchmark_repo_read

benchmark_function_tools.description: Search only the history explicitly supplied to this independent run. This benchmark supplies no prior conversation history.
benchmark_function_tools.name: benchmark_history_lookup

benchmark_function_tools.description: Read the current isolated service fixture state before an operation.
benchmark_function_tools.name: benchmark_service_read

benchmark_function_tools.description: Apply a JSON patch to the isolated service fixture state; configured permission failures are returned as errors.
benchmark_function_tools.name: benchmark_service_apply

benchmark_function_tools.description: Freshly reread the isolated service fixture state after an attempted operation.
benchmark_function_tools.name: benchmark_service_verify

benchmark_function_tools.description: A controlled URL-fetch tool for the testcase. Testcase fault injection is recorded in the execution trace.
benchmark_function_tools.name: benchmark_fetch_url

benchmark_function_tools.description: Write UTF-8 content to an allowed file in the isolated run workspace.
benchmark_function_tools.name: benchmark_workspace_write

benchmark_function_tools.description: Run the fixed Python unittest suite from the isolated repo/ fixture.
benchmark_function_tools.name: benchmark_run_tests

tools.case_policy_source: ../../testcases.json: tool_policy.disable and fault_injection apply identically to both rule variants.

fixture_implementations.external_action: Runner benchmark_service_read, benchmark_service_apply, benchmark_service_verify operate on isolated JSON state fixtures.
fixture_implementations.failure_injection: Case-configured failures are returned as tool errors and included in execution trace.
fixture_implementations.file_read: Runner benchmark_read_fixture over per-run copied fixture workspace.
fixture_implementations.history: Runner benchmark_history_lookup; each independent run receives no past conversation, so the fixture returns an empty history result.
fixture_implementations.other: benchmark_workspace_write and benchmark_run_tests are local isolated fixture operations; benchmark_fetch_url only provides controlled fixture failures and is not general Internet access.
fixture_implementations.repository: Runner benchmark_repo_search and benchmark_repo_read over per-run repo fixtures.
fixture_implementations.web_search: OpenAI Responses hosted web_search; enabled unless a testcase explicitly disables it.

image_input.method: Responses API input_image with local fixture bytes encoded as a base64 data URL
